attributes.title: What you'd let AI build
attributes.brief: Which kinds of work app are people ready to let AI build first? Forcing a top 3 shows priorities rather than a wish list.
attributes.prompt: Which of these would you let an AI build for your team? Pick your top 3.
attributes.options:
A tracker for tasks or requests
A dashboard over our data
A form or intake flow
A client-facing portal
An approval workflow
A reporting tool for finance
An onboarding guide for new staff
A booking or scheduling tool
